title: Monitoring quickstart visual assets: latency, cost-per-token, and trace walkthrough
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Produce a coherent set of onboarding/quickstart visual assets for the Console 'Monitoring' section used in docs, in-product quickstart, and the release notes. The deliverables are annotated screenshots and source frames showing: latency distributions, cost per token breakdowns, trace waterfall snapshots for a single request, per-route drilldowns, and SLO/badge states. Images must include callouts explaining controls (time range, breakdown toggles, model variant selector), and visual examples of automated fallbacks. Include light and dark theme exports, desktop and mobile responsive variants, and versions with sensitive data masked. Exports should be optimized for web docs (PNG @2x) and a compressed web-ready variant (WebP) where appropriate.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with separate frames for each screenshot type (latency histogram + percentile lines, cost-per-token breakdown bar chart, trace waterfall focused on token-level spans, per-route summary) available and linked.
Annotated PNG @2x exports for desktop (1440px width) and mobile narrow (360px width) for each frame.
Callouts added as numbered annotations with accompanying alt text and short captions for docs insertion.
Two theme variants (light/dark) exported and visually validated against accessibility contrast rules.
Sensitive fields redacted and a masked overlay example provided; engineering sign-off on the masking approach.
Assets uploaded to Drive and referenced in the docs PR; images included in the release notes draft.
Design review completed and signoff from PM and Eng (names in reviewers).
assets_needed: PNG @2x exports (desktop and mobile) for: latency-histogram, cost-breakdown, trace-waterfall, per-route-summary, SLO-badge
WebP compressed variants for docs pages
Source Figma frames with labeled annotation layers
Alt text and short captions (one-liners) for each image
A version with redaction overlay demonstrating PII/token masking
notes_for_engineering: Confirm export-safe dashboard endpoints for high-fidelity screenshots to avoid flakiness in test/staging.
Agree on token redaction approach: show aggregated token counts but never real token text in screenshots.
Provide sample query IDs for trace snapshots that are stable in staging so screenshots do not show ephemeral IDs.
Validate that the model-variant selector shown has equivalent labels in production; avoid internal names.
Add a toggle in staging to force the SLO badge into 'degraded' state for screenshot purposes.

final_notes: Aim to keep imagery educational and compact: each screenshot should be usable as a standalone image in the quickstart flow. When possible, use subtle overlays and numbered callouts to keep focus on interaction points rather than raw metrics. After signoff, upload final assets to Drive/docs PR and tag release manager for the release notes package.
